title: Price a one-rank BIT saving and prove the chart-1 receiver cut
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

At the target κ = 0.00389046, changing one rank-two paid event into a rank-one event anywhere in the whole 36-call binary inventory would leave raw surplus 0.862208826193327056… and 268-factor surplus 0.000814475257148468…. A net rank-one deletion would also fund the target. The checker covers all 13 present paid ranks above one, both separately priced suppliers, the six ordinary stages and the 54 strict and four functional signed conditions. A legal changed word and its physical stock, erasure, compiler, precision and analytic application remain open. The complete comparison in #8035 is still κ ≥ 0.0038901152865907.

Chart 1 starts with zero public inputs, receives 505 scalar fields and owes 505 independent outputs. Removing either original chart-510 export leaves only 504 arrivals. This rules out all deterministic repairs keeping the one-scalar contact schedule and output locations, even with free local decoding. For each concrete readout, the normalized public map has rank 629. A named parity annihilates every one of the 2,802 surviving MOVE sensitivities. They span its entire kernel hyperplane. Forward formal-noise propagation and a separate reverse implementation verify the statement.

The complete history of chart 1 pooled with all eligible cheaper senders misses each of the 182 original rank-two or rank-four arrivals at its clock. The finite domain contains 22,200 sender–arrival pairs. A literal relay at clock 8075 changes earlier traffic and preserves the designated rank-two receipt at rank one. Only owner 2326 differs before clock 10137. Supplying a specified 27-input parity there restores the full live state, all 630 public outputs and all 3,433 original clear values. Without that correction nine public rows fail. Retaining all three proposed early exports at chart 531 requires three independent scalars from two arrivals.

## Task and overlap

User-assigned refinement of the P104 paid BIT investigation, based on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Literal graph #8027 `fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4`. Single-band application #8030 `6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb`. Split tariff #8033 `a1313ff9f84fd00d50b282fe432e522191277821`. Signed comparator #8035 `ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9`. Source readouts #8036 `99878b566bfcce80ef7ae2650a1231a203361445`.

#8036 studied the two-export deletion together and priced 25 hypothetical fusions. #8037 studied one omitted helper constraint. #8038 studied two-hop shortcuts. The new package keeps both productive and helper inventories, separates the two readouts, proves a decoder-independent receiver cut and tests shorter ingresses. The chart-388 sink work in #7982 uses a different literal word. Coordination was refreshed in [Discussion #7111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19809538).

## Validation

On CPython 3.12 the following registered gate passed in 22.66 seconds in the isolated test checkout. An independent export of the publication tree also passed.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-single-export-parity
```

Controls include a corrupted source, a wrong live donor, both literal oracle restorations, independent full-map and transpose checks, exact rational projector nesting, signed supplier equality and the failed 24-fusion price. Rational log and exponential series independently confirm the successive-square-root price bounds. The five-file CI prerequisite from #7257 is the exact commit `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026`. The selected-guide test fails on untouched main and passes all six cases with that prerequisite. Its historical registered package passed locally as well.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplied the paired word and physical suppliers. ToikY identified the chart-510 site. DreamingOfClouds’ #7852 and the P104 dual-supplier contributors supplied the research setting. The package preserves the predecessor notices and license. Clear1nsight prepared the proof and replay with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next question

Can either later receipt at 10138 or 10141 be recoded and decoded at chart 1 while supplying chart 531’s later reader and returning the affected owners? A candidate needs exact forward and adjoint rows, real cleanup and the full paid invoice. The exposed 27-input parity and first-reader deadline make this question directly testable.
